entities.name: Mukai Shogen Tadakatsu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mukai Tadakatsu, more generally known as Mukai Shōgen, was the Admiral of the fleet (Jp:お船手奉行) for the Shōgun Tokugawa Ieyasu during the beginning of the Edo period, in the early 17th century.
